decision.detail: Phil lets the afternoon go by in bed alone.
decision.intention: Be on that coach at first light. Be in Pittsburgh by ten. Be at my sister's door by noon. Move the goddamn couch. That's the whole evening. That's the whole point of the week.
decision.words: Rita. I hear you. About Alma. I'll call her from the terminal tomorrow, after I'm off the coach. I'll ask her what she wants to hear. I'll just... listen. I'll do it from a payphone with a three-minute limit and I'll do it. Goodnight.
